item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:50 HKT 17/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea will move towards the vicinity of Hainan Island today. Under the combined effect of the tropical cyclone and the ridge of high pressure over southeastern China, it will be windy over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea. There will be squally heavy showers and thunderstorms over the region today and in the next couple of days. With the tropical cyclone moving into the inland areas of southern China and weakening, showers will ease off gradually and weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 17/08 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 5, occasionally force 6 offshore. Up to force 7 on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier at times. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
